The Passport Reader is a travel document reader and analyzer system and the Fingerprint Scanner is a biometric data provider device by ADAPTIVE RECOGNITION.
The main features of the PR system are:
  • Image scanning with different illuminations
  • Document, character and barcode recognition
  • Authentication of visual elements of documents
  • Reading and authenticating of electronic documents
and the features of the FPS system are:
  • Scanning and segmentation of flat fingerprints
  • Scanning rolled fingerprints
  • Several image quality measurement algorithms
  • Data export to standard file formats
The devices can be used separately. Their controller classes can be found in the Pr22 package. At first, the program must take control over the devices by the UseDevice method. Then, the getScanner method returns the corresponding scanner object. All the scanners have some kind of preview and presence detection functionality. These functions and also the scanning can be parameterized through Task objects.
